items.title: Darius Brubeck interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 29, 2024
items.q: I wasn’t appointed to Champaign-Urbana where I could take over from Dave Sporny or something

ctx.x: Well can you expand on that? Why did it “had to be?” You mean because you wanted it to be or because it was mandated somehow?

I wanted it to be and also it was practical because — well I dropped into a situation where none of this existed before. You know? I wasn’t appointed to Champaign-Urbana where I could take over from Dave Sporny or something, you know. So in order to fill sections, and I never had to apologize or explain this — apologize for or explain this — but I had to draw on every community just to have a band, to have enough trumpet players, trombone players, sax players. And I actually had at first a lot of support from…
